title: Woman accusing David Walliams of grooming her backs staggered age of consent call
summary_full: Comments come after Mia Latter, who alleged she was raped by Russell Brand, had said she wanted a change in lawA woman who has accused David Walliams of grooming her has said she supports a staggered age of consent.Walliams, 55, has been accused of using his power and celebrity status to prey on young women and teenagers for sex, a joint investigation by the Guardian and ITV News has found.Support for anyone affected by sexual abuse issues is available in the UK from Rape Crisis on 0808 500 2222 in England and Wales, 0808 801 0302 in Scotland, or 0800 0246 991 in Northern Ireland. The National Association for People Abused in Childhood (Napac) offers support for adult survivors on 0808 801 0331. Samaritans can be contacted on freephone 116 123. Other international helplines are available for people affected by sexual abuse, childhood abuse, and people in crisis.The ITV News documentary David Walliams: Power and Silence is available to watch on YouTube and ITVX.
